title: Information (the formal charging document)
summary: The charging document filed in the Fourth District Court. It states the counts and the statutory basis the State relies on.

title: Press release: Robinson arrest and potential charges
summary: The prosecutor's announcement of the arrest and the charges the office said it would consider.

title: Affidavit of probable cause (arrest)
summary: The sworn statement supporting the arrest. It describes what investigators say they found, and it is an allegation, not a finding.

title: Probable cause statement (redacted copy)
summary: A redacted copy of part of the probable cause statement, including its account of movements on the Losee Center roof.

title: Formal request for discovery and Rule 404(b) notice
summary: The defense asks the State to turn over evidence and to give notice of any other-acts evidence it plans to use.

title: Defendant's motion to appear at in-person proceedings in civilian clothing and without restraints
summary: The defense asks that Robinson appear in court without visible restraints, citing media coverage.

title: Defendant's reply to the sheriff's response to the motion to appear
summary: The defense answers the sheriff's response on courtroom appearance and restraints.

title: Redacted transcript of a sealed motion hearing
summary: Redacted record of a sealed motion hearing, including discussion of scheduling and sealed filings.

title: State's opposition to the defense motion to disqualify the Utah County Attorney's Office
summary: The prosecutors respond to the defense request that their office be removed from the case, as claimed by the defense because of a conflict of interest. The judge later denied the motion.

title: Invocation of speedy trial rights (filed for the victim's family)
summary: A filing on behalf of Erika Kirk invoking the victim's speedy trial rights.

title: Defense motion on testing of a bullet jacket fragment
summary: The defense asks for an order prohibiting further alteration or testing of a bullet jacket fragment and for a defense expert to examine it.

title: State's opposition to the motion for an order to show cause for alleged contempt
summary: The State responds to a defense request about alleged contempt and discovery tied to publicity about the evidence.

title: Jury trial set to begin June 21, 2028
summary: At a November 9, 2026 hearing the trial court set the jury trial for June 21, 2028.

title: Preliminary hearing argument set for September 1, 2026
summary: Oral argument on probable cause set for September 1, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. MDT.

title: Preliminary hearing to be held July 6 to 10
summary: Hearing set for July 6 to 10, 2026, starting at 9:00 a.m. MDT.

title: May 8 hearing to announce rulings on two motions
summary: Rulings on the motions to continue the preliminary hearing and to exclude cameras from the courtroom, announced May 8, 2026.

title: Judge denies motion to disqualify the Utah County Attorney's Office
summary: Judge Tony Graf denied the defense motion to disqualify the office.

title: Feb. 3 hearing will continue the evidentiary hearing on the motion to disqualify
summary: The evidentiary hearing on the motion to disqualify continued February 3, 2026.
